summary: Frontend-only regression test of the redesigned /demo-trade page (premium dark-green Quotex-style layout). All redesigned surfaces render correctly and are fully interactive on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Login flow, header/tabs/balance/avatar, left icon sidebar, candlestick chart with live GMT clock and all 14 timeframe buttons, right desktop trade panel (stepper + quick amounts + duration picker + payout preview + HIGHER/LOWER), Asset Picker modal (search + 4 category chips + add/close tab), Account Switcher dialog (all 4 account cards with rules), and mobile bottom trade panel all work. No horizontal overflow at either viewport. Trade placement API path works (balance updated -$1 after a $1 HIGHER trade settled).

integration_issues.issue: After placing a 5s HIGHER $1 trade and waiting 12s, balance correctly updated (10004.98 -> 10003.98, $1 loss applied), but the open-trades-count badge still shows '1' and the trade remained visible in the Trades panel. Backend seems to have settled the trade (balance changed) but the client did not receive/apply the s_orders/close event to remove it from openTrades. Likely related to transient websocket warning: 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' seen in console. Not blocking (may be a timing artifact of the preview URL WS) — worth verifying against a longer test window.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}'. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to DialogContent for a11y (Radix requirement).

action_items: (LOW) Investigate why open trade stays in openTrades after settle on preview URL (WebSocket close-before-establish warning). Consider a fallback: after N seconds past close time, re-fetch /api/trade/open to reconcile state.
(LOW / a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} on DialogContent) to AccountSwitcher.jsx and AssetPicker.jsx to remove Radix Dialog console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoTrade.jsx line 291: user initial letter fallback uses `(user.nickname || user.full_name || user.email || 'B')[user.nickname ? 1 : 0]` — the `user.nickname ? 1 : 0` index looks wrong (should be 0 in both cases). If user.nickname is truthy it picks the second character. Cosmetic only.
AccountSwitcher & AssetPicker DialogContent lack DialogDescription — Radix a11y warning surfaced in console.

DemoTrade.jsx: socket.io configured with `transports: ['websocket']` only (no polling fallback) — preview URL occasionally logs 'WebSocket closed before established'. Consider `transports: ['websocket','polling']` for resilience in preview envs.

DemoTrade.jsx: the openTrades list is only pruned via WS `s_orders/close` / legacy `trade_closed`. If either event is missed (e.g., WS reconnect), stale open trades persist until page reload. Suggest a light poll (or a 'settle-past-due' local timer) that calls /api/trade/open to reconcile.
